name: repo-context-verifier
description: Local Codex control bridge with persistent semantic repo memory, adaptive context budgets, process governance, artifact-aware stopping, and evidence-based completion.

interface.longDescription: Local MCP bridge that persistently indexes repository structure, ranks compact context, suppresses duplicate context, governs builds and deployment polling, verifies artifacts, and blocks completion until required evidence is recorded.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Sentinel to begin a governed repository task, select compact semantic context, implement and verify the change, then stop when task_finish succeeds.
